Overview of North Jeolla Region (전북특별자치도)

North Jeolla Region (전북특별자치도) is located in the North Jeolla region of South Korea, with its prefectural capital at Jeonju. Key sights and travel highlights across the prefecture include Jeonju Hanok Village & Gyeonggijeon, Maisan Provincial Park, Naejangsan autumn foliage, Gunsan modern history district.

RegionNorth Jeolla
Capital cityJeonju
Cities & municipalities40
Primary transport hubJeonju Central Station (KORAIL KTX & SRT High-Speed Rail)

How to get to North Jeolla Region

KTX Jeolla Line from Seoul/Yongsan to Jeonju (1h 35m), Iksan and Namwon. Use our KORAIL KTX & SRT High-Speed Rail Fare & Route Calculator and Rail Pass Value Helper to compare rail tickets and regional passes.

Signature local food in North Jeolla

When visiting cities across North Jeolla, look out for these regional specialties at station restaurants, markets, and local izakaya:

  • Jeonju Bibimbap
  • Kongnamul gukbap (bean sprout soup)
  • Choco Pie & Hanok Village street food
  • Jeonju makgeolli table feast

Best time to visit North Jeolla

Best time to visit North Jeolla: Apr–May, Sep–Nov.
